scope: compile-time domain invariants in the benchmark baseline representations

probes.invariant: USD values have exactly two fractional digits
probes.general_purpose_baseline: BigDecimal/System.Decimal values are not nominal USD domains by themselves
primitive long values require a wrapper, validation, or application convention

probes.invariant: USD and EUR nominal values cannot be combined implicitly
probes.general_purpose_baseline: BigDecimal/decimal alone do not encode a currency identity

interpretation: These probes compare the concrete benchmark baselines, not the maximum safety achievable with custom Java or C# domain types, analyzers, source generators, or frameworks.
